posts.title: AI has the same racial bias as old film formulas did
posts.description: Earlier film formulas were engineered with light skin tones in mind. Any image of dark-skinned individuals in light settings results in lost facial detail. In a sense, film was racist. I've heard people dismiss this concept without actually considering it, but that's not the discussion I want to have now. AI has the same bias. posts.title: "Aren't you a robot?"
posts.description: You know those pop-ups that appear when you visit a site and ask you to verify that you're a person? They ask, "Are you a robot?" "But aren't you a robot?" This question gets more and more existential for me as time goes on.
